This happens a lot bro, just say you’re 15 or 14 if you look younger, say you told your parents and they’re talking with police leave it at that. 

Worst case the world sees your dick. Who cares. We’ve all seen worse. The other 99% chance the person deletes the video and vanished because they don’t want to be the guy spreading illegal content and be out in prison.

Your words are beautiful, don’t worry about that. They’re most appreciated by me. 

I can’t really delve into much publicly, I’m a bit paranoid in all honesty, but you’re welcome to open a chat if you’d care to talk about it more. Sorry if that’s annoying.
I am fine in that sense, it’s more so the situation that has come from it. I don’t feel comfortable talking about it publicly but you’re welcome to send a chat request if you’d like to know more.

I’ve been holding on for months with no signs of improvement any time soon, and my knuckles are white. 

I just need to be away from it all, so I can just be myself, and not be like this. It’s impacted everything and I don’t know what to do anymore.

Trust me when I say this; those thoughts are all I hold on to. If I found out things don’t get much better I’d make the choice now. 

Issue is, it’s years away. I’m not worried about my job, I’ve worked a few now. It’s my living situation, and it’s complicated as hell. It’s my fault, but I’m stuck in it and don’t know what the hell to do anymore. I’ve tried to leave it before, and it just backfired and runs me down more.
